notes.title: Servers wipe & Rebalance
notes.content:
Hello!

[h3]Today is the day when all official servers are wiped.[/h3]

Alongside the wipe, I've made a few rebalances to support [strike]weak players[/strike] players who struggled with the AI turrets:  
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of Wanderers per asteroid from 4 to 2.  
[*] Added [b]Ion Accelerator V1[/b] as a default item when spawning into the world.  
[*] Increased the experience scaler for all actions from 1 to 2.  
[/list]

[h3]Who are the Wanderers?[/h3]  
Wanderers are mysterious structures that periodically appear on asteroids, offering both a challenge and an opportunity. While not always friendly, they contain valuable loot-filled chests. Explore eight unique types of Wanderers and discover three varieties of chests packed with rewards.

[h3]Ion Accelerator V1[/h3]  
From now on, every player will spawn with the [b]Ion Accelerator V1[/b]! This pocket ion engine allows you to move quickly across the map. To activate it, select it like any other weapon or tool and hold the left mouse button. Master its use for tactical maneuvers and a speed advantage!

[h3]Experience[/h3]  
The experience multiplier has been increased from x1 to [b]x2[/b]! You'll now earn double the experience from every activity in the game—missions, kills, crafting, and more. Level up faster and enjoy the enhanced progression!

notes.title: Update 0.5.7
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

I want to share the changes that await you in this update. There aren't as many as we would like, but this update has significantly improved the quality of gameplay.

Here's the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added [b]voice chat[/b].
[*] Changed the server pipeline.
[*] Fixed numerous server bugs that led to gameplay loss and world rollback.
[*] Changed the meteorite fall algorithm. Now there will be a correct number of them on destroyed asteroids.
[*] Visually changed plasma weapons. Rebalance of the plasma SMG.
[*] Visually changed all AI projectiles.
[/list]


[b]Voice Chat[/b]
Like everything in this game, it's written by me without using any third-party solutions.
The implementation of voice chat is no exception, and since this is the first public version, there might be issues.
In the settings, you will find:
[list]
[*] Enabling/disabling voice chat. Disabling directly disconnects you from the server, which generally reduces the load on your network and CPU, if that is a critical issue for you.
[*] The volume of everyone speaking around you. Muting does not equal turning off voice chat.
[*] By default, hold "C" to talk. This can be changed in the respective section.
[/list]
[i]You can disconnect and reconnect to voice chat at any time during the game on the server. You don't need to rejoin the server for this.[/i]
The radius in which you hear other players is [b]50[/b] meters. The sound is spatial, so you can always understand where someone is speaking from and how far the player is, as the sound gets quieter the further away they are.



[b]Server Pipeline[/b]
There's not much to share publicly here, but I will include information that new settings are available for server owners.
[list]
[*] Address and port for the voice chat server.
[*] Added runtime world backup. You can find settings related to the frequency and the number of stored backups.
[*] Also added functions for re-registering a public server in the general list of servers and restoring the world from a backup on the fly.
[/list]


[b]Meteorites[/b]
Meteorites have undergone several changes.
[list]
[*] Changed the choice of landing spots. [i]Your base is still not the target of a meteor shower xD[/i]. This was mainly done so that asteroids made up of separate rocks were not deprived of meteorites.
[*] Now the size of the meteorite directly corresponds to the amount of resources it contains.
[*] Changed the amount of resources found in a meteorite, ranging from [b]30[/b] to [b]100[/b] units of resources.
[/list]


[b]Plasma Weapons and AI Projectiles[/b]
Effects of shots, projectiles, and hit effects have been changed for all.
[i]The projectile for plasma rocket launchers remains the old one[/i].
Also fixed is the Defender of the Asteroids projectiles, which sometimes could pass through everything.



[b]Rebalance of the Plasma SMG[/b]
Changes:
[list]
[*] Spread: from 7 meters at 100 meters to [b]2[/b] meters at 100 meters.
[*] Recoil: Horizontal from 1 to [b]0.6[/b], Vertical from 1 to [b]0.3[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.4 Depth of Research and Crafting
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

[b]And here is the new update 0.5.4.[/b]

This update has affected most of the game:
[list]
[*] All research trees have been changed. Added depth of relationships.
[*] Now it is necessary to build and develop a base. Many research workbenches and crafting workbenches have been added.
[*] New upgrades for mining lasers have been added.
[*] The game has been localized into new languages: French, German and Turkish (machine translation).
[*] All localized languages have been updated (machine translation).
[*] Servers and the way of server-client interaction have been optimized.
[*] A new weapon has been added.
[*] Numerous changes to the UI.
[/list]

[b]Research trees[/b]
All the development trees are now structured, connected in the correct order.
They have built-in workbenches for research and for creating objects. Read more further :)
[i]Names:
[list]
[*] Workbench for Research - [b]Research Center[/b]
[*] Workbench for Crafting - [b]Forge[/b]
[/list][/i]


[b]The importance of your own base[/b]
It is extremely necessary to build your own base, because now you can't just create everything anywhere in the universe. To create something, you need to be close, in line of sight with the necessary workbench. Only in this case will you be able to request the creation of an item. But before that, you need to study the subject, as before, but this can only be done by being near the necessary Research Center.


[b]Upgrades for mining lasers[/b]
[i]There are not many upgrades : D[/i]
The progression of the resource extraction skill has been changed. You will definitely need new upgrades.


[b]Servers[/b]
If you do not immerse yourself in technical information, then the optimization of data transmission has increased thousands of times. Really in the thousands..) The most important thing is that the gameplay will become much smoother, although it was almost impossible to notice any lags on the data transfer side before.
In short, the servers are cool now :D


[b]New weapon[/b]
Due to the optimization described above, I can now add rapid-fire weapons. This is how the first plasma submachine gun appeared in the game. Plasma SMG. Its advantage was its high rate of fire, and in combination with good damage makes it very interesting.
But things don't get so sweet... This type of weapon has a fairly high horizontal recoil (pulls right-left) and a small vertical one. The spread is also not the most pleasant.


[b]Changes to the UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a description of each subject, where it is studied, and where it is created.
[*] Added the display of workbenches that are nearby.
[*] Added ammo display.
[/list]

notes.title: Community Servers
notes.content:
Hello!

I would like to introduce you to Community Servers!

Yes, if you don’t like PVP, now you can create both private and public your own server!

You have more than 50 different settings at your disposal. There are 20 really useful things for you :)

Community Servers can be launched by anyone who has the game added to their library. You can do this too :)

You can find everything you need directly in the Steam library in the Tools tab: "Project Asteroids Community Server"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/1c6d79c02bfaac473014b1d794bba67608d6bce9.png[/img]

In general, if you just want to start your local server just for yourself, then you just need to click “LAUNCH” and the server will start.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/b03547971c9d01963509aa7502a4997fc1c3d425.png[/img]

You can connect to it directly in the game via “Direct Connection” or find it on the “Community Server” tab*

* - if the server configuration file indicated that this is not a local server.

Brief information on how to make the server public:
[olist]
[*] You need a public IP on the machine (Windows) where you run the server.
[*] Go to the folder with the downloaded servers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/859665b5235d9b4075cd1aa04ef4284f41b31028.png[/img]
[*] Open the configuration file [b]ServerSettings.json[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/7e930819e8088f2130f17874f36760d38d8dffee.png[/img]
[*] Change the server name ([b]SERVER_NAME[/b]) to the one you want
[*] Write in it your [b]IP[/b] and the [b]PORT[/b] on which you want to run the server

notes.title: Update 0.5.0. Ships
notes.content:
Hello!

Update 0.5.0 will be released on November 6, 2023, at 18:00 CET along with a global server wipe.

This update expands old features, changes the balance, and adds new mechanics!

Changes:
[list]
[*] The cost of creating ammo has changed again. This time the cost has been slightly increased.
[*] The crafts for Plasma Doors and the cost of learning them have been changed.
[*] The tutorial has been completely redesigned.
[*] The ion accelerator, which was in the game before this update, has been renamed V2.
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*] A new turret has been added to the research tree.
[*] Added a new Ion Accelerator V1, which is easy to create at the very beginning.
[*] Added Ship Control Panel.
[*] Added Engine for the ship.
[*] Added a Gyroscope for the ship.
[*] Added an Energy Generator for the ship.
[*] Added ship power element: Equalization rod.
[/list]

Read more about the new ship mechanics.

First, you need to build a regular base, but taking into account the fact that the maximum size of the ship that is currently available is a radius of 10 meters around the ship's control panel.
The ship can include all building elements, placeable objects, and crates.
You can update your ship at any time!

Let's look at an example of building a ship!
[olist]
[*] Build the foundation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/c8e084daf7388cf8f64cb752831ae600e3fa2acc.png[/img]
[*] Next we will place everything we need for survival.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/6603de3245f6b4af13500309fe27b28880e954d3.png[/img]
[*] Let's build the captain's bridge and install the ship's control panel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/50053929855d897f7b026459603ed8464414357f.png[/img]
[*] Let's install engines in all directions:
[list]
[*] If the engine is at an angle, then it will work in all directions in which it can move the ship, but with reduced force
[*] Each engine has a maximum number of buildings it can pull when operating at 100%. If one engine has to pull more buildings, it will not work at full capacity.
[*] The ship has a maximum speed. Even if you leave the ship with a hundred engines, it will not fly faster.
[*] If you do not place the engines in a certain direction, then the ship will not be able to fly in that direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/5dc6171c6b7cc603f9d2cab9e9b8753528297291.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Let's install Gyroscopes for the ship.
[list]
[*] They also have a maximum number of buildings with which it works 100%; with a larger number, it works with less efficiency.
[*] The ship has no restrictions on maximum angular speed. 
[*] The absence of gyros will lead to the fact that you will not be able to control the direction of movement.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/39e4ca46667db6057a60b1e5ebde9fa8a92c4f5f.png[/img]
[*] Next you need to install the Energy Generator for the ship.
[list]
[*] This generator only has one fuel slot. 
[*] If your ship doesn't have a generator, you won't be able to move. 
[*]  If the fuel runs out, your ship will stop.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/5ecd8a02e103dae98aa5e41322c3ea8a6789e9de.png[/img]
[*] After everything is ready, for the ship to become a ship, you need to go to the Control Panel and hold [F]. After this, you will see a notification that the ship is ready.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088628/6472261bd9b4298f3aba93d0bbeba5aea4a19077.png[/img]
[*] Then you can control the ship and finish it off. But after changing the design of the ship, you need to recalculate the ship - the previous point.
[/olist]

Ship control:
[list]
[*] [W A S D] for movement.
[*] [Q] and [E] for longitudinal rotation and Mash for rotation along the other two axes.
[*] If you hold down [L Alt], you can rotate the camera without controlling the ship.
[/list]

The most important thing is not to forget that the ship has inertia and that any collision can lead to irreversible consequences...

notes.title: Update 0.4.9
notes.content:
Hello!

Update 0.4.9 will be released on November 21, 2023 at 18:00 Central European Time!

This update touches almost all parts of the gameplay and fixes many bugs and rebalances. The most interesting part is at the end :)

Bugs fixed:
[list]
[*] Hacking doors by changing the password.
[*] Possibility of destruction of buildings without a building permit.
[*] An endlessly growing list of 3D Printers during respawn and the impossibility of using them in some cases.
[*] Players who are blown up by AFK will disappear.
[*] All types of turrets will fire regularly at enemies.
[*] Many fixes in the UI.
[/list]

Innovations:
[list]
[*] Now you can update the list of owners of the turret so that your ally is not its target.
[*] After dying, you will only lose 50% of Research Points.
[*] The ability to pick up all Placeable Items in the zone where you have a building permit has been added to the Welding Machine. Be careful: when you pick up crates, all the loot in them will disappear!
[*] A new construction element has been added: an equilateral triangle with a side of 2m.
[*] Added translation into Chinese.
[*] Translation errors into Spanish have been corrected.
[*] Now protection from meteorites also blocks all shots from plasma and laser weapons, shots from Guardians and Wanderers.
[/list]

Rebalance:
[list]
[*] At turrets (from the "Placeable" section)
[list]
[*] Increased attack radius from 15 meters to 150 meters.
[*] Increased HP from 100 to 300.
[*] Increased projectile flight speed from 12.5 m/s to 25 m/s.
[/list]
[*] At the red Wanderer turrets:
[list]
[*] Increased attack radius from 15 meters to 30 meters.
[*] Increased HP from 35 to 70.
[*] Projectile flight speed has been increased from 12.5 m/s to 17 m/s.
[/list]
[*] At the pink Wanderer turrets:
[list]
[*] Increased attack radius from 7.5 meters to 15 meters.
[*] Increased HP from 35 to 50.
[*] Projectile flight speed has been reduced from 12.5 m/s to 10 m/s.
[/list]
[*] The repair kit now restores 40HP instead of 25HP.
[*] The cost of creating ammo for all weapons has been changed. See the game for more details :)
[*] The cost of building various building elements has been changed.
[*] The algorithm for selecting the type of meteorites has been changed. The distribution will be more uniform with a predominant amount of stone. 
[/list]

And the biggest change has been the construction system!
[list]
[*] The number of points to which an extension can be made has been increased many times over. For example, a 2x2 meter floor has 25 points instead of 8! This change has so far only affected all types of floors, walls, and constructions.
[*] Changed switching between rotation axes and rotation angles:
[list]
[*] Now the UI displays around which axis the rotation will take place and at what angle.
[*] Added visual display of the axis around which rotation occurs.
[*] Now you don't need to hold down Shift or Alt. The change occurs by pressing the corresponding keys.
[*] When you press Shift, the axes will change in a circle X -> Y -> Z. For convenience, it starts with the Z axis.
[*] When you select a new building item, that object will be oriented in the direction you are facing and will remain there until you point at another object or rotate it yourself.
[*] Pressing Alt will change the angle by which you can rotate the object around its axis. Currently the following rotation angles are available (in degrees): 90 -> 45 -> 30 -> 5.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.8 Wanderer
notes.content:
Say hello to [b]Update 0.4.8[/b], ushering in significant changes in our world exploration. Wanderers, mysterious structures that periodically appear on asteroids, are your new challenge. While they might not always be friendly, they house valuable loot-filled chests. Eight distinct types of Wanderers and three chest varieties await your discovery.

Safe zones have been updated, permitting shooting while limiting damage to objects classified as Placeable Items, adding depth to gameplay.

In other news, starting December 2023, our game's monetization method will shift, marking the end of its free status. However, those who've already added it to their libraries need not fret; the game will remain in your collection.

Prepare for an adventurous journey filled with Wanderers, enticing loot, and a transformed gaming experience as we navigate these dynamic changes together.

notes.title: Update 0.3.37: "Ammo"
notes.content:
Hello!

I come back with a new update!
This update is a significant game-changer. Since this update, you can't just shoot.
For shoot you need AMMO...! 
So, I added 2 groups of ammo and 8 types of ammo. First group: Plasma Ammo, second - Laser Ammo. Abbreviature: PA and LA.

All Ammo list:
[list]
[*] PA: Light
[*] PA: Medium
[*] PA: Heavy
[*] PA: Ultra
[*] LA: Light
[*] LA: Medium
[*] LA: Heavy
[*] LA: Ultra
[/list]

Also, I've updated UI and UX.
[list]
[*]Since this update, you don't need to tap 2 times to switch from one module to another.
For example, if you have Minning Laser in the first slot of ToolBar and in the second Ion Engine. and for now nothing is equipped.
If you press `1` then you will equip Laser, Theeeen if you press '1' again, you will hide laser (like is was).
But, if you equip the Laser and then press '2', you just remove the Laser and equip the Ion Engine.
[*]For more feedback, I've added some frame around equipped item.
[*]Updated all background colors.
[*]Added some notification if you did something wrong. Just for now only if try to shoot without necessary ammo :)
[/list]
